scientific_integrity: The classical Weil bound is used but not claimed as new; the exact 256-word threshold is presented with full code and data. This is a same-model scientific review only, not independent verification.
scientific_limitations: The finite cutoff uses exhaustive deterministic integer enumeration of 11,538 primes below 263681, corroborated independently for all primes through 4000. No formulas for individual word counts or least witnessing indices. Possible broader historical formulations, particularly Emma Lehmer (1983), have not been fully excluded.
title: Sharp universal threshold for all 256 consecutive quartic-coset quadruples
